objective: 把Strategy exploration ledger改为accepted Run绑定且按身份穷尽分区的fail-closed投影

semantic_brief.summary: 当前ledger仍接受调用者替换Run/intent/depth并用detached unresolved/frontier count与clamp编译。本增量仅在既有Agent证据owner下，用accepted Run context和identity evidence生成精确partition。
core_points: Agent ledger入口不再接受caller-supplied provenance
Visited只来自verified return/completion或RecordOnly fresh evidence
Pending是Discovered减Visited减Unresolved的身份补集，unknown frontier只是RecordOnly Visited子集注解
任何身份或sequence矛盾直接失败而非clamp

change_principles: 把Agent.CompileExplorationLedgerView改为零参数Strategy-bound projection；RunId、RuntimeExecutionIntentReference、rules、depth semantics和declared depth只能读取同一个AcceptedExplorationRunContext，legacy非Strategy Run调用必须抛出InvalidOperationException
删除full-ledger compiler的caller-supplied runId/intent/explorationIntent/depth入口；full compile只接受internal accepted context和同一Agent owner的immutable per-scope identity evidence
per-scope evidence包含BranchProgressEvidence、unresolved identity set、RecordOnly identity-to-observation-sequence map、unknown-frontier identity set和revisit coverage identity set；不得重新引入detached count

DiscoveredIds等于ApprovedSiblingEvidence.Keys；VisitedIds等于CompletedSiblingEvidence.Keys、verified boundary source identities和RecordOnlySatisfied.Keys的并集；UnresolvedIds来自classification-unavailable set；PendingIds为严格补集且与authorization/dispatch无关

验证completed/verified-boundary/record-only/unresolved/frontier/revisit每个identity均在approved inventory；Unresolved与Visited不相交；UnknownFrontier为RecordOnly子集；RecordOnly sequence必须与该identity accepted inventory source sequence一致；失败直接throw，不得clamp/drop/manufacture
保留现有legacy depth行为；DeriveRules/DeriveDepthSemantics若仍供legacy使用，full Strategy ledger不得调用它们重新派生已准入语义
canonical scope顺序和identity/sequence correlation必须参与LedgerDigest，使相同证据同digest、同count但不同identity evidence不同digest；可用internal correlation material，不新增wire/schema字段
迁移旧测试：legacy Agent路径只能断言Strategy ledger不可用；scope compiler测试全部改用identity evidence；accepted Strategy binding测试证明ledger metadata与同一admitted semantics精确一致且Agent公开projection入口无可替换参数
acceptance: reflection或direct test证明Agent.CompileExplorationLedgerView为零参数，accepted Strategy ledger的Run/reference/rules/depth逐项等于AcceptedExplorationRunContext，legacy path抛出且不能fabricate ledger
compiler exact-accounting test：approved identities a,b；a verified visited、b unresolved，结果discovered 2/visited 1/pending 0/unresolved 1且不double-count
classified unsatisfied identity无论是否authorized都保持Pending；dispatch/authorization本身不进入Visited；verified boundary disposition可进入Visited
RecordOnly identity进入Visited且source sequence被验证；unknown frontier同时Visited并作为其子集注解，不增加Discovered
out-of-inventory unresolved/record-only/frontier/revisit/verified-boundary、Unresolved与Visited重叠、frontier非RecordOnly子集、record-only sequence不匹配分别fail closed，源码不存在count clamp
两组count完全相同但identity或observation sequence不同的合法evidence产生不同LedgerDigest；相同evidence在不同输入枚举顺序下产生相同ledger/digest
现有ledger/depth/unresolved/run-binding测试按新truth迁移并通过，原58个WI-RESAR定向回归仍通过，Runtime build 0 error且git diff仅scope.write
forbidden: 禁止新增或修改StrategyDirective、run.strategy.start、wire DTO、protocol version或外部schema
禁止新增Evidence owner、状态系统、持久化、Memory、dynamic depth或scenario knowledge
禁止把AuthorizedSiblingEvidence、Tap、dispatch receipt、GoalEvidence或terminal state当作Visited依据
禁止用count subtraction heuristic、clamp、silent drop或重复增加unresolved修正矛盾
禁止修改Agent.OpenWorld、Planning、FSM、Traversal、GoalEvidence、OpenSpec、文档、WorkItem或其他已有改动
escalation: 若identity-correct accounting需要改变公开wire/schema或新增evidence/state owner，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW
若现有BranchProgress/RecordOnly/Unresolved证据不足以构造D4 partition，列出缺失identity与真实路径并停止，不得猜测
若legacy隔离无法在不改变既有Run行为下实现，保留失败证据并返回Leader
